changes: D1: docs/layout.md now gives each part of a list row one place: title, details, a status on its own line in a p.sv-list__detail, a row action last in the main part, and the amount alone in the trail. changes: The lint's HTML parser now records each element's open ancestors, so it can tell when a control sits inside a <label>.

New lint rules, applied to screens and to the html code blocks in the notes: html-many-primary (any file whose name begins demo- is exempt; each code block in a note counts as its own page), html-form-no-action, html-button-no-type, html-control-no-label, html-heading-order and html-placeholder-label.
html-control-no-label collects every label for= value in the page first, so a label written after its control still counts. An empty aria-label or aria-labelledby counts as no label.

html-heading-order allows one h1 and never a jump of more than one level going deeper. A page whose first heading is not h1 fails; a code block that is a fragment is exempt from that part. A page with no headings produces nothing.
data-length added to the option attributes whose values must appear in a selector of the built CSS.

The lint now also reads the html code blocks in docs/layout.md, docs/patterns.md (when it exists) and AGENTS.md, as well as docs/components/*.md. A code block that begins <!doctype is linted as a whole page: the theme script is allowed, the stylesheet link is required, and links resolve as if the page were in screens/.

Lint self-test changes. It now fails unless all 24 named rules are seen failing; before, any 12 were enough. A fixture whose name begins demo- must produce nothing. Fixtures that must keep a fixed name state what they expect in a <!-- lint-expect: ... --> comment. Fixture AGENTS.md and docs/patterns.md fail, which proves those files are now linted. Fixture docs/layout.md is clean, which proves a whole page in a code block is accepted.

New screen check overflow-inside-part. It measures text word by word with a Range, so a trailing space at a line end does not count, and compares it with the border box of every ancestor with an sv- class that is not scrollable. Above an ancestor that clips, only the text still inside it counts. Each part is reported once per state, with its class and the amount.

New screen check many-accent-fills. It reads --sv-color-accent on :root through the canvas and flags more than one visible element whose background matches it within 1 per channel. Pages whose file name begins demo- are exempt. The check is skipped when the token is missing or not opaque.
The screen self-test's list of rules that must be seen failing now includes the two new rules. demo-accent-fills.html proves the demo exemption.
check-screens.mjs takes a new --out <folder> option, so a --dir run can write somewhere other than scripts/.tmp/check-screens-out. I used it to keep my runs inside my own scratch folder.
